name: Francisco Assis - Après le § 56 - Am 6
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: 56a. Calls on the Council to halt further migration from radical Islamic countries, such as Afghanistan, as it risks importing fundamentalist practices that undermine, in particular, women’s rights in Europe; urges Member States to halt the mass influx of migrants from such countries, largely composed of young adult males, and to swiftly enforce readmission agreements to return illegal migrants and those posing a threat to security within the EU;
